'''Alexander Georgievich Mazhuga''' (also spelled as '''Majouga''', {{langx|ru|Александр Георгиевич Мажуга}}; born 6 August 1980, [[Moscow]]) is a Russian political figure and a deputy of the [[8th State Duma]]. In 2013, he was granted a [[Doctor of Sciences]] in Chemistry degree.<ref name=ТАСС>{{cite web
|url=https://tass.ru/encyclopedia/person/mazhuga-aleksandr-georgievich
|title=Мажуга, Александр Георгиевич
|publisher=ТАСС
|language=ru
|accessdate=2022-03-04}}
</ref>

In 2003, Mazhuga started working at the [[MSU Faculty of Chemistry]]. He is an author of scientific 15 patents, including international ones. From 2018 to 2021, he headed the [[D. Mendeleev University of Chemical Technology of Russia]]. Since September 2021, he has served as deputy of the [[8th State Duma]]. On 12 October 2021 he became the First Deputy Chairman of the State Duma Committee on Science and Higher Education.<ref name=ТАСС/><ref>{{cite web
|url=https://rg.ru/2021/09/24/spisok.html
|title=Список избранных депутатов Государственной Думы РФ восьмого созыва
|date=2021-09-25
|publisher=Российская газета
|language=ru
|accessdate=2022-03-05}}
</ref><ref>{{cite web
|url=https://indicator.ru/chemistry-and-materials/aleksandrt-mazhuga-rhtu.htm
|title=Когда ученым быть обидно: интервью и.о. ректора РХТУ
|date=2017-09-01
|publisher=Indicator
|accessdate=2022-03-06}}
</ref>

In 2019, Mazhuga took 44th place among the 118 youngest scientists in the world.<ref>{{cite web
|url=https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/4031945
|title=Александр Мажуга, химик
|author=Елена Кудрявцева
|date=2019-08-05
|publisher=Коммерсантъ
|accessdate=2022-03-06}}
</ref>

In February 2022 voted for recognition of the independence of Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Госдума и Совет Федерации единогласно одобрили договоры с ДНР и ЛНР |language=ru |work=BBC News Русская служба |url=https://www.bbc.com/russian/news-60475345 |access-date=2022-04-09}}</ref> Publicly supported the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Александр Мажуга: Эту бойню нужно остановить, именно поэтому Россия начала спецоперацию |url=https://moscow.er.ru/activity/news/aleksandr-mazhuga-etu-bojnyu-nuzhno-ostanovit-imenno-poetomu-rossiya-nachala-specoperaciyu |access-date=2022-04-09 |website=moscow.er.ru |language=ru}}</ref>

Expressed concerns about potential development of the biological weapon in the eastern Ukraine and warned about the potential use of the biological weapon against Russia.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Александр Мажуга: Парламентское расследование работы биолабораторий на Украине поможет установить факты ведения против России биологической войны |url=https://er.ru/activity/news/aleksandr-mazhuga-parlamentskoe-rassledovanie-raboty-biolaboratorij-na-ukraine-pomozhet-ustanovit-fakty-vedeniya-protiv-rossii-biologicheskoj-vojny |access-date=2022-04-09 |website=er.ru |language=ru}}</ref>

== Sanctions ==
He has been sanctioned by the European Union,<ref>{{Cite news |title=ЕС решил ввести санкции против 351 депутата Госдумы в ответ на признание ДНР и ЛНР |language=ru |work=BBC News Русская служба |url=https://www.bbc.com/russian/news-60483789 |access-date=April 9, 2022}}</ref> Switzerland,<ref>[https://www.seco.admin.ch/dam/seco/de/dokumente/Aussenwirtschaft/Wirtschaftsbeziehungen/Exportkontrollen/Sanktionen/Verordnungen/Russland,%20Ukraine/situation_en_ukraine_delta_2022-02-25.pdf.download.pdf/Situation%20en%20Ukraine_Delta_2022-02-25.pdf Situation en Ukraine_Delta_2022-02-25] seco.admin.ch</ref> the United Kingdom,<ref>[https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/1067417/Russia.pdf Russia] service.gov.uk</ref> and the U.S.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Russia-related Designations; Publication of new Frequently Asked Question |url=https://home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financial-sanctions/recent-actions/20220324 |access-date=April 9, 2022 |website=U.S. Department of the Treasury |language=en}}</ref>
